references.text: Establishes the death penalty for anyone who strikes a person so that they die - the same principle that murder requires death
Concerns intentional killing and that the murderer must be taken from the altar to die - no refuge for murderers
God's fundamental command that whoever sheds human blood shall have their own blood shed - the basis for the death penalty for murder
Whoever strikes a person dead shall die - confirms the principle of the death penalty for murder
Concerns one who hates their neighbor and kills them - no mercy is to be shown, and bloodguilt must be removed from Israel
Defines what makes a person guilty as a murderer deserving death - the context for why ransom cannot be accepted
Explains that bloodguilt defiles the land and can only be atoned for by the blood of the killer - the reason why ransom is forbidden
Solomon's proverb that one who carries bloodguilt must flee to the grave - no one should help them
